70% cap on cumulative fine reductions is penalty mechanics, not a threshold

reference_scope: full text (consolidated law as amended through Amendment 13, incl. Schedules; Tier B: thresholds and key dates only)
notes: Tier B, long Hebrew text (124K chars) read in full by the checker. All threshold and event items judged (no section over 40). Both versions capture the core scope thresholds (registration >10,000; notification >100,000 sensitive; 5 databases; DPO >10,000; database exclusion <=100,000), the Third Schedule security-tier cutoffs, the 1,000,000 fine-doubling tiers and the micro/small business turnover tiers. X adds 7 penalty-mechanics rows (fine floors, 5% turnover cap, 70% and 30% reduction caps) judged unsupported, and codes the 5/3-year clean-record reductions with trigger 'benefit' (wrong_type). Y adds the election-period window as a threshold (unsupported). Both miss s. 2(5) (letters under 15 years) and s. 31 (newspapers appearing every <= 40 days); X also misses the 2-year repeat-violation window; Y misses the 5/3-year clean-record reductions. Events: both record the four key dates (1981 adoption, s. 37 relative commencement, 2028-08-14 police phase-in, 2026 first indexation) and many procedural deadlines, judged correct as deadline events (separate articles, so not duplicates). X's 'suspended' election-period row judged unsupported. The text states no adoption or commencement date for Amendment 13 itself.
